Note: Theon’s work is explicitly a commentary on Ptolemy’s Almagest, explaining and elaborating its astronomical and mathematical procedures and contributing to the later transmission and study of Ptolemaic astronomy.

Secondary Name: Demotic Magical Papyrus of London and Leiden
Note: The Demotic Magical Papyrus of London and Leiden is incorporated into the modern corpus of Greek and Demotic magical papyri as PDM XIV. Index 49 therefore represents a specific manuscript contained within the broader scholarly corpus represented by index 23.
